title: P1 endocrine-electrolyte-osmotic credibility refactor
breaking_changes: Exogenous insulin action now enters two serial SC depots instead of plasma directly.
Older RL checkpoints using insulin must be retrained.
known_limitations: SC insulin uses model-units, not clinical insulin units.
Glucagon extension is reduced-order and lacks epinephrine/cortisol/growth hormone.
Transcellular K model does not yet distinguish all acid species or beta2 kinetics.
Oral water absorption is instantaneous before osmotic redistribution.
Historical long-horizon renal/acid-base tests truncate at the 725-min episode boundary; they do not establish 24-h behavior.
algorithmic_changes: Event-replay meal fitting skips the independent exercise simulation branch.
